== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Power Of The Hutt (V)]]: the PC card image of [[Power Of The Hutt (V)]] (18 June 2023, [[:File:V21-D-powerofthehutt-original.png|V21-D-powerofthehutt-original.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (page 2). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
